body_lead: CHENNAI: The Tamil Nadu government on Tuesday signed an agreement with Sarvam AI to establish India’s first full-stack Sovereign AI Park, positioning the state as a hub for domestically governed artificial intelligence infrastructure. The memorandum of understanding envisages an initial investment of Rs 10,000 crore and the creation of about 1,000 high-skilled jobs in advanced computing and AI research.
